newsitem.title: UK: Pillar Property sells 40 mln stg properties.
newsitem.headline: Pillar Property sells 40 mln stg properties.

text.p: Britain's Pillar Property Investments Plc said on Monday it had sold five properties for 40 million stg as part of its portfolio management activity.
Pillar said it had sold three office properties and one retail park to National Provident Institution for 33.25 million stg.

The offices were in Warrington, north west England, Reading, west of London, and in Edinburgh. In a separate transaction, Pillar sold Consort House in Glasgow to Strathmore Assets for 6.6 million stg.
The company said the total sales receipts exceeded values of the properties as at March 31, 1997 after allowance of sale costs.
